The retained source contains303 qualified Week7 rows;282 remain omitted by the newer lag policy. Earlier historical publication clocks remain unknown and will not be relabeled.

Please coordinate any official additional common-cutoff capture/admission through the existing producer and preserve every early Week8 packet. V2 is preparing distinct immutable research shadows for only the thirteen still-open games, with real inference/persistence clocks, frozen subgroup/grading rules and no outcome inspection; owner acknowledgement/admission and official capture will be recorded separately. No paid collection, scheduler/workflow dispatch, shared ledger change, website publication or production modification is requested or performed.

V2's prior frozen checkpoint is84b5619bc24894ed64803378df2699063c301361, draft review package https://github.com/NickNicky19/NFL-forecasting-V2/pull/1 . Its ordered-feature ablation is a new reconstruction mechanism test on V2 inputs, not a claim to reproduce your original issuance. Please identify any overlapping active V2-input experiment before duplicate work. Public aggregates/hashes will follow; private rows remain in the approved companion.
